# Landing Party {.unnumbered}

{{< clip media/clips/landing.mp4 poster="media/clips/landing.jpg" caption="A Kessler-Hayashi lander comes down and its camp starts to build." >}}

Landing Party adds three factions to Nauvis. Two are corporations that land, mine, build factories and field armies of
their own. The third takes over biter spawners and breeds its own biters. All three compete with you for the planet,
and with each other.

They do not arrive at the start. Each one comes when your factory reaches a certain point, so the pressure grows with
you. [Arrivals](arrivals.qmd) has the timeline.

## The factions

**Grubstake** comes first, around chemical science. It is a mining company that lives off your factory. It carries off
machines, skims your belts, robs your chests, strip-mines the ore under your outposts and claims ore you leave unmined.
It avoids defended ground, and the wild biters leave it alone. See [Grubstake](grubstake.qmd).

**Kessler-Hayashi** comes when you launch your first rocket. It is a security contractor, at war with you from the day it
lands. Its camps are walled and paved, and it pushes a line of posts out toward your base. It brings tanks, walkers,
railgunners and sieges with mortars and howitzers. See [Kessler-Hayashi](kessler-hayashi.qmd).

**Synthexis** comes when the wild biters' evolution reaches {{< var synthexis.arrive_evo >}}. It takes over a spawner
field far from you, feeds it on your pollution and sends planned waves of bred biters at your defenses. See
[Synthexis](synthexis.qmd).

The corporations also fight each other. See [Rivals](rivals.qmd).

## What you get

Faction bases can be destroyed. Their wreckage holds parts you cannot make yourself. Crafting those parts unlocks
technologies built from their designs, and a command core from their wreckage lets you build a barracks and raise
[your own army](army.qmd). [Spoils](spoils.qmd) lists what drops where and what it unlocks.

## Before you start

- Landing Party needs Factorio {{< var mod.factorio >}} with Space Age. This manual describes version
  {{< var mod.version >}}.
- Chat notices are off by default. A faction's first landing and a destroyed faction base are always announced. Turn
  on **Chat notices** in the map settings to hear about everything else. See [Mod settings](reference.qmd#sec-settings).
- Each faction has a strength and an aggression setting, from ×{{< var settings.very_low >}} to
  ×{{< var settings.very_high >}}.

## Using this manual

[Reference](reference.qmd) has every unit and building with its numbers, the chat commands and the settings.
[Tips](tips.qmd) collects what works against each faction.
